body: I am not to sure why I was banned but apparently for "Ban Evasion". I don't know what that means but when I was banned the moment before I will explain what happened. So I had Junr follow me to get on this really high tower we had to mine down on. He mined a block and fell down I don't know how that is a ban. I am assuming because I said "Rip" and "lol" because it was funny. Not so sure how I get banned for trying to get help and he fell by accident when all I was trying to do is make a secret path to the enemys base and needed help. Would like to have an unban and if not maybe a talk to Junr asking what I did wrong.

replies.author: JrCanadian
replies.body: I bought this account off my friend. Payed him 15$. He is my friend from school I didn't pay him online I payed him at his house. My old account was also named "JrRichy" a long time ago. Please give me a chance you will never see any complaints of me. Remember when I was playing in your lobby's these past few days? That was the real me. Not one complaint and no hacks. My computer isn't even able to download hacks its pretty bad. I will even tell you the hole story of how I lost my old account. I had vip on multiple servers and had this one friend I trusted so greatly. He wanted to borrow my account to try out a vip on a server. So I trusted him. I gave him the password and said we can share this account. After that he changed the password and said "I forgot it and so we sent the code thing to reset it on my phone but my phone wasn't getting them. So I contacted Google and mojang and they couldn't do anything. Its been about 4-5 months without it so I got bored and wanted to play mc again. So I bought it off my friend Josh. Junr I know it is hard to believe but you have to believe me I am not lying I swear. I am 16 and mature, I know how boring hacking is it ruins the fun because you will know you are always gonna win and it ruins it for others. I prmise you Junr I did buy this account off my friend. Please think about it sir this is the one of the good servers I played on that the old owner wasn't banned off of. Just think about it I promise you Junr, I promise.
